# ExpressCheckout

A row of wallet buttons above the form with an “OR” line under it. The buttons are placeholders for a payment provider’s own. While loading they pulse grey; their colours then fade in over 300ms. Below 480px they stack.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/expresscheckout)

## Usage

```tsx
<ExpressCheckout
  loading={!walletsReady}
  buttons={[
    { id: 'fast', label: 'Fast Pay', background: '#5a31f4', onClick: payFast },
    { id: 'wallet', label: 'Wallet', background: '#ffc439', color: '#111' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `buttons` | `{ id, label, content?, background?, color?, onClick? }[]` | One per wallet. `content` shows a logo in place of the text; `label` then names the button for screen readers. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Grey pulsing placeholders. |
| `label` | `string` | Text above. Defaults to the “Express checkout” label. |
| `dividerLabel` | `string \| null` | Text on the line below; null for no line. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `ExpressCheckout.module.css`
- `ExpressCheckout.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/checkout/CheckoutProvider.tsx`](../CheckoutProvider.tsx)
- [`src/labels.ts`](../../labels.ts)
- [`src/lib/money.ts`](../../lib/money.ts)
- [`src/primitives/Divider`](../../primitives/Divider)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
